canonical.spec: SHA-256 of normalized UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, Unicode retained
canonical.note: Values still enter the store: baseline.summary/labels hash the normalized managed value; description baselines hash the normalized managed content string.

transportInvariant.spec: 16 hex chars: FNV-1a 32 over the space-joined alphanumeric word sequence, concatenated with a positional weighted-sum 32 over the same sequence
transportInvariant.reason: The MCP Code Mode sandbox exposes neither crypto.subtle nor BigInt, so an in-call SHA-256 of remote Jira description text is not computable. Local file bytes are hashed with real SHA-256 outside the sandbox.
transportInvariant.upgradePath: Re-compute observed.remoteDescFingerprint as canonical SHA-256 when a capable runtime is available; do not treat the 16-hex value as prune-grade proof.
